name: Keyboard and mouse
author: Keros and the OpenRAC contributors
description: Plays Ratchet & Clank and Going Commando with a keyboard and mouse: WASD moves, the mouse turns the camera, left click fires, holding right click opens the Quick Select and the mouse picks its slot, Space jumps, Escape pauses. In menus the arrows move, Enter confirms and Escape or Backspace go back; the wheel scrolls. Every action can be bound to any key, mouse button or wheel direction, two binds each. While you use them the game's button icons show your keys. Built into OpenRAC: a gamepad keeps working beside it, and the game switches between them by what you touch last.

settings.name: Horizontal sensitivity
settings.description: How far the camera turns left and right when you move the mouse.

settings.name: Vertical sensitivity
settings.description: How far the camera turns up and down when you move the mouse.

settings.name: Invert vertical
settings.description: Mouse up looks down. The game's own invert options are for the controller.

settings.name: Camera tilt
settings.description: Whether the camera behind Ratchet keeps the tilt the mouse gives it, or levels out as the game does when the mouse rests.

settings.name: Lock the cursor in play
settings.description: Hides the cursor and keeps it in the window while you play; menus and pausing let it go.

settings.name: Move forward
settings.description: Pushes the left stick forward.

settings.name: Jump
settings.description: Cross. Also confirms in menus and skips scenes and movies.

settings.name: Walk (hold)
settings.description: Moves at the walk speed below while held.

settings.name: Walk speed
settings.description: How far the walk key pushes the stick.

settings.name: Ramp-up time (ms)
settings.description: How long the movement keys take to push the stick all the way: a tap nudges, a hold runs.

settings.name: Fire
settings.description: Circle: fires the weapon or gadget in hand.

settings.name: Melee (wrench)
settings.description: Square.

settings.name: Strafe (hold)
settings.description: L2. Ratchet & Clank: only with the lock-strafe mod (its Hold mode strafes with it).

settings.name: Crouch and strafe (R2)
settings.description: R2, held. Ratchet & Clank: crouches like R1, strafes in water. Going Commando: strafes and crouches.

settings.name: Quick Select (hold)
settings.description: Triangle, held: move the mouse toward a slot and let go to take it.

settings.name: Quick Select dead zone
settings.description: How far, in pixels, the mouse moves before the Quick Select points at a slot.

settings.name: Next weapon
settings.description: The next Quick Select slot that holds something.

settings.name: Previous weapon
settings.description: The previous Quick Select slot that holds something.

settings.name: Slot 1
settings.description: Takes the item in that slot of the Quick Select at once (slot 1 is the top, then clockwise).

settings.name: First-person view (hold)
settings.description: L1, held.

settings.name: Reset camera
settings.description: Swings the camera round behind him and levels it.

settings.name: Map
settings.description: Select.

settings.name: Pause menu
settings.description: Start in play: the pause menu. In menus it goes back; in a scene or a movie it skips.

settings.name: Key icons on screen
settings.description: While you play on the keyboard and mouse, the game's button icons show your keys (Space, LMB...).

settings.name: Mouse in menus
settings.description: In menus the cursor points at the game's items, a click confirms, right click goes back and the wheel scrolls.

settings.name: Confirm
settings.description: Cross in menus and dialogs (Space does it too); on the map it travels (Circle). Skips a scene or a movie.

settings.name: Back
settings.description: Triangle in menus; Escape does it too. Skips a scene or a movie.

settings.name: Up
settings.description: The d-pad in menus (held, it repeats); WASD move there too.

settings.name: Down
settings.description: The d-pad down in menus.

settings.name: Left
settings.description: The d-pad left in menus.

settings.name: Right
settings.description: The d-pad right in menus.

settings.name: Second action (Circle)
settings.description: Circle in menus and dialogs, where the game asks for it: yes to creating save data or formatting a memory card, the Quit page's quit, a value stepped back. On the map, Enter and a click already travel.
